name: Exhibition
line: A small exhibition: a title wall in condensed vinyl capitals, then scrolling walks sideways through five lit rooms (Hooke's cork, Snow's map, the two explorers' network drawings, the three games as a quiet trio), each object framed on a mat with a museum wall label, while a floor-level plan marks the room you are in; it becomes a vertical sequence of rooms on phones, short screens and with reduced motion.
notes: Rooms: I How sure (Hooke's cork, with the four groups), II Same certainty, very different size (Snow's map, with the figures), III and IV the two explorers, V the games; Code Against Cancer is the dark wall on the way out. The Hooke and Snow labels use only the title, date and credit from media/credits.json; no curatorial claims are made about them. The sideways walk only runs above 860 px wide and 600 px tall with motion allowed; otherwise, and without JavaScript, the rooms stack. Focusing a link inside a room scrolls the walk to that room. Sofia Sans and Sofia Sans Extra Condensed include Cyrillic.
